scope: Actual browser visual review of experimental sweet hair donors; not production acceptance

observations: The real generated extremes moved the outer hair silhouette visibly at 260 pixels.
Linear intermediate positions -0.75, -0.25 and 0.25 showed multiple translucent strand outlines in native crops.
Hair tips near original-image y438-445 mixed with static shoulder-adjacent tips and visibly ended at the mask edge.
Five distinct donor files did not establish a smooth or acceptable animation.
imagegenFivePoses.action: Removed from release selection. Never enlarge the mask into clothing to hide the seam.

observations: Original texture preserved hair topology and avoided the generated shoulder-tip mismatch.
Neighbour-frame alpha blending still produced shallow double outlines at native scale.
Linear boundary weighting caused a visible slope change at maximal displacement.
originalGeometryNineFrames.action: Replaced the experimental approach with a smooth single-position geometric sampling candidate, which requires separate pixel, visual and performance validation.
